newsitem.title: UK: Surveys point to rising industrial output-Treasury.
newsitem.headline: Surveys point to rising industrial output-Treasury.

text.p: Output figures from the British economy for the second half of 1996 showed the "wheels and cogs of manufacturing turning faster," Angela Knight, Treasury economic secretary said in a statement after December output figures were published.
"And recent business surveys show higher production on the way in 1997," Knight added.
